Malformed declared round profiles fail before generic fallback; stale/freed native owners are refused.
Four moving-start fixtures seed initial position/velocity/facing once, then mapped controls/native physics; not full ordinary approaches.
Public runner registration was inspected, but the private observer invoked modules directly; actual integrated runner remains required.
limits: No graphical/moving naturalness, whole-game, target-Mac or AAA pass.
D022 critical rapid late-landing uprighting remains open and independent of this round-coping repair.
The existing 100 micrometre contact skin is retained; zero-overlap and force-bearing are not inferred from this bounded skin proof.
Constructor component memory diagnostics and helper-level query bounds do not certify whole-frame CPU/GPU timing.
